description: Allowlist of EXPECTED VM-vs-JIT divergences, pinned by corpus id (WF-0B). A non-MATCH on a listed id is reported but does not fail the run; a MATCH on a listed id is flagged for removal. Add entries ONLY with an audit/issue citation — this file must never become a dumping ground that greens a red gate.

knownClasses.jit-double-execution: Audit 2026-07-04 §4(a): runtime JIT failure with un-carved-out signal -1 re-runs the whole program under the interpreter, duplicating side effects (print('BEFORE') twice); 19/738 book programs hit this path. Shows up as DIVERGED (stdout duplicated under jit).
knownClasses.i64-overflow-wrap: Audit 2026-07-04 §4(b) / D3 ruling 2026-06-01: default-mode JIT emits plain iadd/isub/imul and wraps where the VM raises the checked overflow error. Shows up as VM_FAIL (vm exit 1, jit exit 0, different stdout).
knownClasses.annotation-hooks-dropped: Audit 2026-07-04 §4(c): annotation before/after hooks silently dropped when the caller JIT-compiles (JIT calls the un-wrapped impl). Shows up as DIVERGED.
knownClasses.hashmap-filter-garbage: Audit 2026-07-04 §4(d): arity-2 HashMap.filter/map rewritten to Array-only filterIndexed/mapIndexed; vm errors cleanly, jit prints a different pointer-like integer each run with exit 0. Shows up as VM_FAIL or DIVERGED (nondeterministic jit stdout).
knownClasses.hof-return-kind-raw-bits: WF-0B baseline 2026-07-05 (repro: acceptance program finding_s1_unknown_hof_return_kind_confusion): a higher-order-function return whose kind is unproven is printed as a raw f64 bit pattern under jit (vm '6.0' vs jit '4618441417868443648'), both exit 0. Shows up as DIVERGED, deterministic.
knownClasses.jit-object-merge-field-add: WF-0B baseline 2026-07-05: object merge `a + b` with overlapping keys computes wrong field values under --mode jit (partial-native top-level + SURFACE fallbacks on stderr: W39 F1 LoadModuleBinding / c4-4B TryUnwrap) while vm produces documented merge-override semantics (or its own clean error). Deterministic across runs; verified by hand 2026-07-05.
knownClasses.compile-blowup-timeout: Audit 2026-07-04 'Parser exponential blowup' (CONFIRMED, shape.pest:1099): compile phase alone exceeds the 10s/mode harness budget in BOTH modes; with a 60s budget the program produces the identical compile error in both modes (would be MATCH). Harness-budget artifact of a known compiler-performance bug, not a VM/JIT divergence.

entries.reason: Synthetic repro committed by WF-0B: add_pair(i64::MAX, 1) — vm raises checked overflow (exit 1), jit prints -9223372036854775808 (exit 0). Classified VM_FAIL.

Synthetic repro committed by WF-0B baseline 2026-07-05: vm prints STEP1 STEP2 AFTER; jit fails natively at runtime with signal -1 after the prints, re-runs the whole program under the interpreter and prints STEP1 STEP2 STEP1 STEP2 AFTER (exit 0). Classified DIVERGED. Verified by hand against the worktree binary.

Synthetic repro committed by WF-0B baseline 2026-07-05: vm errors 'no method filterIndexed on receiver kind Ptr(HashMap)' (exit 1); jit prints a different garbage integer each run (exit 0) — e.g. 4816060185762492416 vs 4816146652915635200 on consecutive runs. Classified VM_FAIL, jit stdout nondeterministic. Verified by hand against the worktree binary.

vm prints the @math before/after hook lines then '5 / PROBE4_OK'; jit prints only '5 / PROBE4_OK' — the annotation hooks are silently dropped when the caller JIT-compiles. Classified DIVERGED, both exit 0. Verified per-id in the 2026-07-05 baseline run.

vm prints '6.0'; jit prints '4618441417868443648' (a raw f64 bit pattern) — the acceptance-gate S1 finding this probe program was written to capture. Classified DIVERGED, both exit 0, deterministic. Verified per-id in the 2026-07-05 baseline run.

entries.reason: Both modes SIGKILL at the 10s harness budget during COMPILE (identical behavior); with a 60s budget the vm run completes in ~27s and exits 1 with the compile error both modes would print ('E0100: cannot push a Tok value into an array whose element type is Tok'). Not a VM/JIT divergence — a known compile-time blowup exceeding the harness budget. Classified TIMEOUT. Verified per-id by a 60s hand run 2026-07-05.

notes: All entries were pinned from the 2026-07-05 baseline run (tools/vmjit-diff/baseline-2026-07-05.txt) after PER-ID hand verification — no bulk import. Zero book-tier ids diverged in the 465-program baseline: the audit's book-tier double-execution/HashMap.filter classes do not trigger inside the 240 runnable-fence subset (earlier constructs force compile-time whole-program deopt, after which both modes agree deterministically), so those two classes are held live by the SYN__ synthetic repros instead. If a future run turns a known-red entry into MATCH, remove it here.
